people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.
translations.bsb: First to those in Damascus and Jerusalem, then to everyone in the region of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, I declared that they should repent and turn to God, performing deeds worthy of their repentance.
translations.kjv: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
translations.asv: but declared both to them of Damascus first and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judaea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.
